card.name: Comma after a clause-ending noun
card.fires_on: Mostly the comma right after a drug name or noun that ends a list-like instruction or clause, such as 'discontinue DRUG,' in overdose text. Also some partway-through-phrase words like 'reference' or 'radii'.
